Notes: THE SCRIPTED MOMENT IN THE OPENING MATCH. While flag:tutorial_match is set they take their strongest card, play it FACE UP so you cannot miss it, and pour a Fire Brew on it - which is how you find out brews exist at all. Order 5 puts it above every other rule. Set the flag with flag:tutorial_match in a Progression row before the match and clear it with flag:tutorial_match=false after

THE ROW THAT MAKES SHOW COST SOMETHING. The moment you play a card face up they stop guessing and take their best answer in that tier - and if the card they take has a reveal ability of its own they put it face up too, so you see what is coming. Read top to bottom: the FIRST rule whose When is true is the one they use

Tier IV is the shot, so they lead with a card that actually does something and they show it if showing it does anything. if_ability means they never play a plain card face up - there would be nothing to gain
Ahead, they keep their ability cards in hand for later tiers and play something plain. A side protecting a lead
Behind, they stop saving anything. Strongest card in the tier, face up if it has a trick on it

THE CATCH-ALL, and it must be last. Any tier none of the rules above claimed is picked at random and played face down - which is exactly what the opposition did before this file existed. Delete every other row and the game plays as it used to
